facts.fact: Max 感到血契的力量像钩子一样扎进她的灵魂，只有 Oracle 或许能帮忙，因此她必须尽快前往 Haven
facts.quote: Only the Oracle might be able to help me—another reason to reach the Haven, another reason to hurry.

facts.fact: Max 告诉 Xander 她今晚不跟他走，要求独处祈祷三天来权衡这一切
facts.quote: “I’m not leaving tonight. I need time to weigh all of this. Three days. Alone, in prayer.”

facts.fact: Aelindor 抢在 Xander 开口前挡在两人之间，强行要求他准许这三天
facts.quote: “The lady has asked for three days.” His voice was velvet drawn over a blade, courteous all the way to the edge of insult.

facts.fact: Xander 答应给三天，临走前用 Missy 睡得安稳、姐姐就要回家的说法敲打 Max
facts.quote: Missy sleeps so much easier these nights, knowing her sister will be coming home to her.

facts.fact: 在接头点，Max 摘下脖子上的项链、脱掉礼服换上战斗装备，Nikolai 与 Caspian 也同时换装，Max 伸手压下两人的怒火
facts.quote: At the rendezvous I pulled the necklace from my throat, stripped out of the gown, and buckled into my battle gear.

facts.fact: Max 定下优先顺序：先救出妹妹，血契的事以后再算
facts.quote: “We get my sister out first,” I said, cinching the last strap tight. “We deal with the contract after.”

facts.fact: Caspian 说没有打不开的锁，他们要为血契找到或造出一把钥匙
facts.quote: “No lock was ever forged that someone, somewhere, couldn’t cut a key for. We find the key—or we make one.”

facts.fact: Caspian 与 Nikolai 第一次握手达成一致，随后 Nightingale 小队在黑暗中悄然出发，插入敌人腹地
facts.quote: While the monster worked the ballroom below us, gloating over a victory he thought was certain, the Nightingale team slipped into the dark.

relations: Max 向 Xander 争取三天独处时间，Aelindor 以强硬姿态逼 Xander 答应
Xander 以 Missy 为筹码胁迫 Max
Nikolai 与 Caspian 因 Max 首次达成一致（握手言和）
Max、Nikolai、Caspian 组成 Nightingale 队伍，准备潜入敌境先救出 Missy
Oracle 是唯一可能被指望解除血契的对象
